Talk to Thaddiel to find out more about the Scavengers in [[Old Ascalon]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| complete = [[The Great Northern Wall]] mission
}}

===Objectives===
* Go to the ruins in Old Ascalon. Clear out any scavengers.
* Return to Warmaster Tydus for your reward,

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Battle Axe (hatchet)|Battle Axe]] [[of Fortitude]]
** [[Slashing Dmg]]: 6-16 (Requires 3 [[Axe Mastery]])
** Health +25
** +15% damage (vs. Charr) ''Inherent Mod''

==Walkthrough==
* Walk out of [[Sardelac Sanitarium]] and take the way at your right. Talk to [[Thaddiel]] and click the following answers to fulfil the quest: 
# "What are you doing here?"
# "I have order to clear the area of scavengers."
# "Only if you make yourself useful."
* The quest will be updated and you can map to Ascalon City for the reward.

==NPCs==
===Allies===
[[Human]]s ([[Ascalon]]ians)
* {{mo}} 10 (20) [[Thaddiel]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
;Warmaster Tydus
:''"I'm getting reports of '''scavengers''' in the ruins of the '''army citadel''' in Old Ascalon. I sympathize with the poor, but anything left in those ruins is the property of the King's Army. I need you to investigate and clear out any scavengers."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I understand. I'll take care of it.
| decline = I have no interest in harassing the poor.
}}

===Reward Dialogue===
;Warmaster Tydus
:''"So you had a run-in with this scavenger Thaddiel, did you? From what I've heard of him, I do not doubt he will attempt to return, but my men will be instructed to keep an especial watch for him. Good work clearing the ruins."''

==Notes==
* Originally, the [[Battle Axe (hatchet)]] that is given as reward in this mission, had different upgrades, allowing to put two [[Axe_Grip|grips]] at the same time. Doing this, for example, combinations of two Axe Grips [[of Enchanting]] were possible, providing a permanent +40% longevity in enchantments. This was modified in the [[Game_updates/20051220|December 20, 2005]] game update and all the axes inside the game were forcibly changed to the current one (including the ones inside the inventory [[backpack]]).
